message: Hi Alex, it's Aisha at Pearl Dentistry, sounds good, let's do it. How do I pay and when do you start?
reply: Hi Aisha, great news! I'll send a payment link by email today (card, covers the $900 fix pack). Once paid, I'll start within 1-2 business days and let you know what I'm fixing before making changes. If you'd also like the $250/month care plan for ongoing upkeep, just say so and I'll include it. Thanks for trusting us with this!
